notes.name: led_driver.md
notes.text:
+5V self-flashing LED driver:
- Created led_driver.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch directly in /home/cua/kicad_project/ using KiCad GUI. Step 56 shows clean title and explicit saved status.
- Q1 Transistor_BJT:2N3904 mapping: 1 emitter, 2 base, 3 collector. Device:LED rotated once has cathode down; D1 value LED_Flashing, D2 LED.
- R1=1k supply-to-collector, C1 Device:C_Polarized=100uF collector-to-GND, R2=10k base-to-GND, R3=4.7k supply-to-D2-anode. D1 anode +5V, cathode base; D2 cathode collector. Five nets, no signal labels, plain +5V/GND symbols.
- ERC step55 reported only two undriven power inputs (#PWR01/#PWR02), zero warnings. Clear markers (440,722), close (605,722), Ctrl+S.
- No feedback errors or ineffective repeated actions recorded. Symbol chooser and properties text were inspected before acceptance; small batches and planned wiring sequences worked.
- Current design is visually checked, not independently simulated or scored. D1 requires internal current limiting; higher D2 brightness depends on LED selection. Prior simple edits scored 1.00 while populated circuits scored 0.00-0.67, so these observations establish workflow/persistence, not exact evaluator matching.
